body.p: The W3C QT4 test suite (qt4cg/qt4tests) and the XSLT 4.0 test suite (qt4cg/xslt40-test) are committed under third_party/qt4tests/ and third_party/xslt40-test/ at a pinned commit, recorded in third_party/<suite>.commit. tools/update-test-suites.sh moves them to a new commit. Test lists in tests/qt4/ refer to test cases by name. Revised 2026-10-16: first fetched on demand into an ignored directory; the owner asked for them to be vendored so they are not downloaded again for every session and CI run. From xslt40-test, report/, admin/unicode.xml, the zipped QT3 tests and the DocBook toolchain .jar files are left out, because no test reads them (about 370 MB remain for both suites). The W3C XML conformance suite (xmlts20130923, 17 MB) is vendored the same way under third_party/xmlconf/ for the XML parser (see grammars/xml/README.md). Pinned commits: qt4tests 166453359bd7770fb113b6d9c9015df7f7fa5d02, xslt40-test 91328fbf0fed4a5d2813eb3661808ee53cb961ba (both HEAD on 2026-10-16). Spec applicability: a test-case spec dependency replaces the test-set one; no spec means all versions (see docs/QT4_CATALOG.md).
